input.body:
label: bug
file: src/export/csv.ts
The issue is that the CSV writer in src/export/csv.ts merges rows with identical date, amount, and description, ignoring the currency difference. This causes transactions with different currencies but otherwise identical data to be merged into one row. The problem lies in the CSV export logic, so src/export/csv.ts is the file responsible.
